name: picker
description: THE PICKER'S THEME (2026-10-04, the chrome round): themes/warptempo.json with the chrome as ONE KNOB, its ground #191919 under the chrome rule (`chrome`: Windows 95's proportions, every relief line, the field and the emboss's light copy following the ground; at #191919 the theme warptempo's own row), the canvas #0E0E0E, the ink #A6B9DE (the ink round's latest pick), the outline by its rule ("auto": the 50 % linear-light blend of the ink over the canvas), the selected fill #666666 (fixed this round). Exported with --export for tools/palette/picker/: three elements in the architect's order of importance (2026-10-04), Chrome, Canvas and Ink, the chrome active, all over the scene `waveform` (the ink round's: the marker stems, the flags, the playhead and row 8's state line switched off). The later rounds come in this order, each a new element and scene here and a new export: the unselected flag, the selected flag, then the open flag with its selection (where the selected fill becomes pickable).
